meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后,当你提供 cmem.ai 的同步凭据时,Claude 会帮你把它们安全存入插件配置,让记忆捕获生效;它不会在对话中回显你的密钥。
howto.when: 当你说「设置 claude-mem」「连接 cmem」「添加我的 cmem key」等,或提供 cmem.ai 的连接凭据时触发。

say.text: 把 claude-mem 和 Cowork 配对。
这是我的 cmem key,帮我配置好。
say.note: 至少需要 sync token,另两项可选。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you provide cmem.ai sync credentials, Claude stores them in the plugin config securely so memory hooks work. It never echoes your secret in chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up claude-mem, pair claude-mem, connect cmem, add your cmem key, set up cloud sync in Cowork, or provide cmem.ai Connect values.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my sync token, user id, and SyncHub URL.
say_en.note: It extracts and writes them without echoing the secret.
It asks for at least the sync token.
